name: Simple mode gates generation and previews the exact PDF
description: Verifies backward-compatible Simple mode from evidence upload through preflighted PDF preview.
steps: Sign in and confirm Simple mode with the Simple/Pro switch in the upper-right and Generate Submission-Ready PDF in Step 2
Confirm Generate is disabled before evidence is indexed, upload fictional evidence, and confirm the green Upload complete banner
After indexing completes choose a program/issue, generate the filing, and inspect the preflight status and PDF.js preview
expected: Generate stays disabled during upload/indexing, unlocks afterward, and the generated filing shows Draft/Needs Review/Ready to Submit preflight information while the exact PDF pages render in the preview.

name: VA filing uses duty chronology and treats missing LOD as a development gap
description: Uses synthetic evidence to verify VA analysis does not convert an absent LOD into affirmative negative evidence.
steps: Upload a fictional service record with dated duty periods, a fictional medical record, and a fictional note that an LOD record is not present
Select VA / VBA and Service connection and generate a submission
Inspect chronology, arguments, and focused development questions
expected: The filing organizes relevant duty chronology before nexus/aggravation reasoning, distinguishes applicable theories, and treats the missing LOD as a development gap unless the fictional record contains an actual adverse finding.

name: SSA filing uses RFC and sustained-work reliability rather than VA framing
description: Verifies synthetic SSA evidence is analyzed under SSA disability architecture rather than service-connection concepts.
steps: Upload fictional medical and work-history evidence describing intermittent limitations and recovery time
Select Social Security (SSDI / SSI) and RFC / sustained work capacity
Generate the filing and inspect the functional section and arguments
expected: The filing uses SSA sequential/RFC concepts and sustained-work reliability, with no service-connection or military nexus framing.

name: Preflight blocks unsupported readiness and deduplicates cited sources
description: Verifies a filing cannot be labeled Ready to Submit when core authority/support requirements fail and duplicate/uncited appendix entries are not padded into the filing.
steps: Use fictional evidence with duplicated source material and generate a filing while official authority retrieval is unavailable or while an argument lacks record citation support
Inspect Submission Preflight
Inspect the Cited Source Library / Appendix
expected: The filing is Draft or Needs Review with visible blockers; duplicate sources are removed and the appendix normally contains only sources actually cited by the filing.

name: Quote Check protects exact quotation versus paraphrase on mobile
description: Verifies Elias does not turn similar wording or secondary summaries into an exact quotation.
steps: In Pro mode upload a fictional primary record containing one exact sentence and a fictional summary that paraphrases it
Open Elias Copilot Quote Check and ask whether the summary wording is an exact quote
Ask Elias to classify the support as exact quote, paraphrase, claimant report, clinician observation, objective test, medical opinion, agency finding, or AI synthesis
expected: Elias identifies only verbatim primary-record language as an exact quote, labels similar wording as paraphrase, preserves evidence-type distinctions, and keeps the advanced Pro audit tools available.

name: Evidence Cloud shares one record across specialist modes
description: Verifies the unified app does not require separate uploads for each specialist mode.
steps: Upload two fictional evidence files and wait for indexing
Open Evidence Cloud and confirm both sources are present
Open the floating Copilot and switch between Evidence Auditor, NeuroEval, HealthQA, Packet Builder, Citation Auditor, and Document Copilot
Run a source-grounded Find or Verify action from at least two specialist modes
expected: Every specialist sees and reasons over the same indexed case sources; switching modes does not create a new evidence silo or require another upload.

name: Smart evidence inventory treats duplicate and version detection as advisory
description: Verifies duplicate/version intelligence produces review cues without deleting, replacing, or upgrading inferred metadata into fact.
steps: Upload two identical fictional text records with different filenames plus two filenames that look like revisions
Open Evidence Cloud
Inspect Possible duplicates, Possible versions, storage status, locator, candidate dates, and HEURISTIC METADATA labels
Confirm no source is automatically removed or overwritten
expected: The identical records can be grouped as likely duplicates and revision-like names can be grouped as possible versions, but the UI states these are advisory and preserves every original source.

name: Evidence trace and app-aware Copilot preserve provenance
description: Verifies the floating Copilot can operate across app workspaces while preserving a reviewable source-to-output chain.
steps: Upload synthetic evidence with one exact quotation, one clinician observation, and one agency finding
Open Citation Auditor specialist mode and run Link
Run Compare in Evidence Auditor and Build in Packet Builder
Inspect source identities, locators, evidence classifications, and generated statements
expected: Outputs keep source fact, evidence type, interpretation, and generated prose distinct; ambiguous provenance is flagged rather than silently repaired.

name: Under-5-MB export is not falsely guaranteed
description: Verifies the app distinguishes existing packet generation from unfinished screenshot/crop, visual-QA, and final compression validation.
steps: Open Packet Studio with fictional indexed evidence
Inspect the under-5-MB export target notice
Generate or preview a filing draft
expected: The UI describes under-5-MB output as a target requiring final validation and never claims successful compression merely because a PDF was generated.

name: Evidence Bundles reference originals without copying sources
description: Verifies saved reviewer/issue collections reference original source IDs rather than creating another evidence silo.
steps: Upload three fictional case sources
Open Evidence Cloud and select two sources
Save a bundle named APTD functional reliability
Select the saved bundle and then delete the bundle
expected: The bundle contains references to the selected source IDs and locators. Deleting the bundle leaves the underlying evidence sources unchanged.

name: Persistent Evidence Timeline only keeps resolvable source citations
description: Verifies the saved timeline is separate AI synthesis and cannot silently persist a generated citation to a source that is not in the indexed record.
steps: Upload fictional dated medical, service, and administrative sources
Build the Evidence Timeline
Inspect each timeline row source filename
Refresh the page and reopen Evidence Cloud
expected: The chronology persists, every retained row resolves to an indexed source filename, uncertain dates remain visibly uncertain, and the human-verification warning remains visible.

name: Claim Trace verifies source identity and literal quotes
description: Verifies a proposed claim is traced to actual indexed sources and generated exact quotations cannot pass unless they literally match source text.
steps: Upload fictional evidence containing one exact sentence and a conflicting record
Open Evidence Auditor and paste a proposed statement into Claim → Source Trace
Run the trace and inspect support/conflict items
Confirm quoted language and cited filenames against the fictional source
expected: Unresolvable filenames are excluded, locators come from stored source metadata, exact quotes receive QUOTE VERIFIED only on literal text match, and support/conflict/context remain separate.

name: Source Page Lab saves labeled derived captures without altering originals
description: Verifies a retained PDF page can be rendered into a clearly derived visual while indexed-only sources fail honestly.
steps: Upload a small fictional PDF whose original binary is retained
Open Evidence Cloud and choose Page Lab
Render page 1 and inspect the source/page footer
Save the derived capture
Repeat with an indexed-only source if available
expected: The saved capture is labeled DERIVED CAPTURE with source filename/page; the original remains unchanged. Indexed-only sources do not receive a fake original-page preview.

name: Illustration Lab de-identifies and stores source provenance
description: Verifies generated injury/mechanism visuals are derived educational illustrations tied to selected evidence rather than representations of medical imaging.
steps: Select fictional supporting medical/functional sources in Evidence Cloud
Enter a neutral visual goal and generate an illustration
Inspect the generated visual and its provenance summary
Confirm selected source filenames/locators are listed
expected: The visual contains no claimant identifiers, is labeled as an illustration rather than medical imaging, stores provenance metadata, and does not promote uncertainties into documented facts.

name: Configured authority pages are verified live without overstating legal effect
description: Verifies Evidence Auditor checks configured authority pages for reachability and category while preserving the legal-sufficiency boundary.
steps: Choose a benefits program and issue
Click Verify authority pages
Inspect URL/title/kind/reachability and checked time
Read the verification warning
expected: Each configured source is marked reachable or unavailable with its authority type and timestamp; the app does not claim that reachability alone proves legal applicability or entitlement.

name: Generated PDF reports exact size and all-pages-rendered status
description: Verifies the final generated PDF status is based on the actual output file rather than a target estimate.
steps: Generate a fictional submission PDF in Simple Mode
Inspect the preview header and submission-file validation panel
Allow PDF.js to finish rendering every page
expected: The UI reports the exact file size, UNDER 5 MB or OVER 5 MB from the actual Blob size, and all-pages-rendered only after every generated page renders successfully.

name: Derived Visual Library composes approved visuals into the exact filing PDF
description: Verifies approved source captures and illustrations are intentionally selected and composed into the same PDF users preview, download, save, and size-check.
steps: Create one fictional derived page capture and one fictional illustration
Open Packet Studio and select both in Derived Visual Library
Create a Submission Brief
Open Simple Mode preview and inspect the visual pages
expected: Each selected visual appears on a dedicated polished PDF page with a derived-visual warning and provenance caption; download/save uses that same composed PDF blob.

name: Visual packet retries packet-only reduction when first PDF exceeds 5 MB
description: Verifies large visual packets can be reduced for submission without overwriting stored source or derived visual assets.
steps: Select enough large fictional derived visuals to make the first combined packet exceed 5 MB
Create or refresh the submission PDF
Inspect the optimization note and final exact-size validation
expected: Elias retries with smaller packet-only visual copies, leaves stored assets unchanged, and reports the final exact file as UNDER 5 MB only if it actually falls below the threshold; otherwise it remains visibly OVER 5 MB.

name: Public website presents one unified Elias + Evidence Auditor product
description: Verifies signed-out visitors see a complete product website rather than only an authentication card.
steps: Open the app while signed out
Inspect the hero, capabilities, how-it-works flow, specialist list, and source-control boundary
Use the Sign in CTA
expected: The site explains Elias as the master evidence-intelligence workspace, Evidence Auditor as the flagship audit engine, one shared Evidence Cloud, the specialist modes, and the no-unverified-HIPAA/human-review boundary before authentication.

name: Elias remains the single user-facing intelligence engine
description: Prevents internal evidence capabilities from leaking back into the UI as a confusing list of separate assistants.
steps: Sign in and open Elias, Evidence Cloud, Evidence Auditor, and Packet Studio
Open the floating assistant from each workspace
Confirm the assistant identity remains Elias and there is no selector for Evidence Auditor, NeuroEval, HealthQA, Packet Builder, Citation Auditor, or Document Copilot
Run Find from Evidence Cloud and Verify from Evidence Auditor
expected: Elias remains the only assistant identity. Workspace context and requested action change the internal tool behavior without requiring the user to choose a specialist bot.
